ops.body: DECISION RECORDED 2026-07-19 (cc-steer note 703bed77, build task 5e51c5fc): the 9B deploys HOSTED — vLLM bf16 on Modal behind one athome serve-layer abstraction (spike proved AUC parity 0.92953 vs local 0.93169, with hosted tracking the Tinker substrate at median |Δ| 0.0022 vs local 4-bit's 0.0251; LoRA serves unfused via --enable-lora, no mlx-lm counterpart needed). Local 8B stays the active default; the hosted switch is a deliberate operator action after the build lands. The mlx-lm-LoRA-counterpart path (option a) is dead — hosted (option b) won, and via Modal/vLLM rather than TinkerBackend.sample (sample remains a fallback candidate backend under the same contract).
